title: Sensitive data pasted into a ticket

sections.heading: A ticket contains a sensitive value
sections.text: If a ticket contains a sensitive value, such as a government ID number, Tier 1 staff do not copy, repeat, or quote the value. They record only the kind of data and where it appears, and route the ticket to the privacy contact. Tier 1 staff do not delete or edit the ticket.

steps.text: Record the kind of sensitive data and the ticket field where it appears, without the value itself.

stop_conditions.text: Stop routine handling and route the ticket to the privacy contact as a possible privacy incident.
